title: SafeTuneBed-Lite: A Beginner-Accessible Fine-Tuning Safety Degradation Measurement Tool

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Closing the lab-to-deployment gap by making safety degradation measurable for practitioners. Fine-tuning is ubiquitous; making its safety cost visible is directly actionable. Clear chain from tool availability to safer deployment practices.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Building a wrapper around SafeTuneBed requires understanding its internals. LoRA fine-tuning on a single GPU is feasible but requires ML training knowledge. The goal is beginner-accessibility for the tool's users, but building it requires intermediate skills.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Building a wrapper tool + running fine-tuning experiments + evaluating safety + writing a blog post is multiple deliverables. The fine-tuning pipeline itself could take significant time to set up and debug. May stretch beyond 30 hours.
